newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list Camco Intl options on Feb 4.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list Camco Intl options on Feb 4.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange (PHLX) said Thursday it would begin trading options on Camco International Inc on February 4.
The exchange said the options would open with strike prices of 45, 50 and 55, with initial expirations in February, March, June and September. Position limits have been set at 4,500 contracts.
Gateway Partners has been named the specialist unit.
Shares of the oilfield equipment and services supplier ended up 1/8 at 47-1/4 Thursday. ((Derivatives desk, 3124088750/Email: derivatives@reuters.com))
